source_notes: Machine-readable sidecar for drift tests; Markdown docs remain human-facing only.
Full-detail rows cover Dinghy commands sent now or planned for v1. Comprehensive expansion continues in later Phase 6 plans.

commands.name: server.connection.identify
commands.purpose: Identify Dinghy as a Moonraker websocket client before subscriptions.
commands.success_semantics: JSON-RPC result acknowledges the client connection.
commands.error_semantics: JSON-RPC error reports invalid or unauthorized identify params.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Dinghy requires a non-blank url param and treats auth errors as AuthRequired.

commands.name: printer.objects.list
commands.purpose: List available Klipper status objects for live capability derivation.
commands.success_semantics: JSON-RPC result contains an objects array.
commands.error_semantics: JSON-RPC error means the handshake cannot derive capabilities.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Dinghy derives Capabilities from the returned raw object names.

commands.name: printer.objects.query
commands.purpose: Read a point-in-time status snapshot for selected Klipper objects.
commands.success_semantics: JSON-RPC result contains status data for requested objects.
commands.error_semantics: JSON-RPC error reports invalid object names or unavailable Klippy state.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Dinghy seeds PrinterState from the snapshot and uses configfile one-shot reads best-effort.

commands.name: printer.objects.subscribe
commands.purpose: Subscribe to printer status diffs for selected Klipper objects.
commands.success_semantics: JSON-RPC result contains the at-subscription snapshot.
commands.error_semantics: JSON-RPC error reports invalid object names or unavailable Klippy state.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Dinghy seeds from the subscribe reply before entering Connected.

commands.name: server.temperature_store
commands.purpose: Read recent temperature history for graph backfill.
commands.success_semantics: JSON-RPC result contains temperature arrays by sensor object.
commands.error_semantics: Dinghy treats failures as best-effort and leaves graph backfill empty.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Only live-detected heater objects are consumed.

commands.name: printer.gcode.script
commands.purpose: Run Klipper G-Code through Moonraker.
commands.success_semantics: JSON-RPC result arrives after the script completes.
commands.error_semantics: JSON-RPC error carries Klipper rejection text and is surfaced as a non-fatal dispatch failure.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Dinghy dispatches with the long gcode timeout and byte-identical PrinterCommands output.

commands.name: printer.emergency_stop
commands.purpose: Emergency-stop Klippy from Dinghy's confirm guard.
commands.success_semantics: JSON-RPC result acknowledges the e-stop request.
commands.error_semantics: Dispatch failure is surfaced without leaking credentials.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Uses the short default dispatcher timeout, not the gcode timeout.

commands.name: printer.firmware_restart
commands.purpose: Restart Klipper firmware from recovery UI.
commands.success_semantics: JSON-RPC result acknowledges the restart request.
commands.error_semantics: Dispatch failure is surfaced through the common dispatcher path.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Later registry wrappers preserve existing recovery dispatch semantics.

commands.name: printer.restart
commands.purpose: Restart Klippy host process from recovery UI.
commands.success_semantics: JSON-RPC result acknowledges the restart request.
commands.error_semantics: Dispatch failure is surfaced through the common dispatcher path.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Later registry wrappers preserve existing recovery dispatch semantics.

commands.name: server.files.metadata
commands.purpose: Read slicer metadata and thumbnails for a selected gcode file.
commands.success_semantics: JSON-RPC result contains file metadata and thumbnail descriptors when available.
commands.error_semantics: Dinghy treats missing metadata as optional and renders null-safe fallbacks.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Only fetched one-shot by filename; never polled.

commands.name: server.history.list
commands.purpose: Read recent print history for the idle Status last-job card.
commands.success_semantics: JSON-RPC result contains count and jobs.
commands.error_semantics: Dinghy treats failures as no last-job data.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Fetched once per not-printing transition, not as a polling loop.

commands.name: SET_HEATER_TEMPERATURE
commands.purpose: Set a heater target temperature.
commands.success_semantics: Klipper accepts the script and target changes in status updates.
commands.error_semantics: Klipper rejects invalid heater names or values with gcode error text.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Dinghy clamps numeric target values in PrinterCommands before dispatch.

commands.name: G28
commands.purpose: Home all axes or selected axes.
commands.success_semantics: Klipper accepts the homing script and updates toolhead.homed_axes.
commands.error_semantics: Klipper rejects unavailable axes or unsafe homing conditions.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Dinghy's homeXY wrapper must emit G28 X Y and never home Z.

commands.name: G1
commands.purpose: Move an axis or extrude filament.
commands.success_semantics: Klipper accepts the motion command and status updates reflect movement.
commands.error_semantics: Klipper rejects out-of-range moves or cold extrusion with gcode error text.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Dinghy wraps relative motion/extrusion in SAVE/RESTORE_GCODE_STATE.

commands.name: M84
commands.purpose: Disable steppers.
commands.success_semantics: Klipper accepts the script and motors disable.
commands.error_semantics: Klipper rejection is surfaced as a gcode dispatch failure.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Dinghy routes through ConfirmGuard before dispatch.

commands.name: TURN_OFF_HEATERS
commands.purpose: Turn off all heaters.
commands.success_semantics: Klipper accepts the script and heater targets fall to zero.
commands.error_semantics: Klipper rejection is surfaced as a gcode dispatch failure.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Dinghy uses the exact PrinterCommands.COOLDOWN constant.

commands.name: SAVE_GCODE_STATE
commands.purpose: Save parser state before temporary mode changes.
commands.success_semantics: Klipper stores state under the supplied name.
commands.error_semantics: Klipper rejection is surfaced as a gcode dispatch failure.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Dinghy builders use this in multiline jog/extrude scripts.

commands.name: RESTORE_GCODE_STATE
commands.purpose: Restore parser state after temporary mode changes.
commands.success_semantics: Klipper restores state previously saved under the supplied name.
commands.error_semantics: Klipper rejection is surfaced as a gcode dispatch failure.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Dinghy builders use this in multiline jog/extrude scripts.

commands.name: M83
commands.purpose: Set extruder to relative mode.
commands.success_semantics: Klipper switches extrusion distance mode for subsequent commands.
commands.error_semantics: Klipper rejection is surfaced as a gcode dispatch failure.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Dinghy uses M83 only inside SAVE/RESTORE wrapped extrusion scripts.

commands.name: FORCE_MOVE
commands.purpose: Move a single stepper without normal kinematic checks.
commands.success_semantics: Klipper accepts only when force_move is enabled in config.
commands.error_semantics: Klipper rejects when force_move is unavailable or disabled.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Dinghy exposes this only through the explicit override path.

commands.name: LOAD_FILAMENT
commands.purpose: Run the user's load-filament macro when present.
commands.success_semantics: Klipper accepts the macro script and runs printer-defined behavior.
commands.error_semantics: Missing macro is handled client-side as an informational popup.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Runtime gating uses Capabilities.hasMacroIgnoreCase.

commands.name: UNLOAD_FILAMENT
commands.purpose: Run the user's unload-filament macro when present.
commands.success_semantics: Klipper accepts the macro script and runs printer-defined behavior.
commands.error_semantics: Missing macro is handled client-side as an informational popup.
commands.acceptance_semantics: Runtime gating uses Capabilities.hasMacroIgnoreCase.
